description: A FastAPI application defining an endpoint '/items/' that uses a dependency class 'CommonQueryParams' to handle common query parameters such as 'q', 'skip', and 'limit'. It simulates data retrieval from a fake database and filters results based on query parameters.

classes.name: CommonQueryParams
classes.description: A class encapsulating common query parameters: 'q' (optional search query), 'skip' (pagination offset), and 'limit' (pagination limit).

methods.name: __init__(self, q: Union[str, None] = None, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100)
methods.description: Initializes the CommonQueryParams instance with optional 'q', and default 'skip' and 'limit' values.

methods.name: read_items(commons: Annotated[Any, Depends(CommonQueryParams)])
methods.description: Asynchronous endpoint handler for GET requests to '/items/'. It utilizes the CommonQueryParams dependency to filter and paginate items from the fake database.
